summary: Compare publication and reconcile launch changes against the running incarnation's start evidence.

replay.detail: Adds rebuildable local publication evidence. Existing stores bootstrap retained runtime observations and start-success evidence after API bind in durable, bounded writer pages. Explicit full replay resets this evidence to an incomplete bootstrap; no claim rewrite or derived-table version change.

schema.detail: Adds six local derived tables and lookup indexes over those small tables, plus exact source-delta triggers. A local launch-source generation invalidates cached evidence on repair, trim and replay; one constant-size commit-observer read publishes that invalidation. No new index scans the claims or local_observations table at open. Numeric schema version and replicated claim bodies are unchanged. Claim deletion coalesces canonical-position repair per batch in a durable queue instead of rescanning the batch for every removed row; repair remains bounded and evidence stays Unknown until it finishes. A separate startup correction compares directive-note record trigger definitions against sqlite_master and replaces them only on a real change; unchanged opens preserve the schema cookie while older definitions upgrade once.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and replicated digests are unchanged. Publication fact tables, pending deltas and bootstrap progress are explicitly local derived state in the canonical audit and never participate in shared digests.

compatibility.detail: Publication preview and reconcile share a judgment against the checked origin and running incarnation, including declaration drift and distinct Unknown evidence. Incomplete bootstrap is fail-closed for the internal writer guard, with publication-evidence-incomplete visible in doctor. Default adopted runtimes continue running when launch evidence is missing. No public CLI option is added in this slice; mixed-build fleets have not been exercised.

downtime.detail: Source-table index builds were rejected after a 71.26-second estimate on the frozen production census. Native WAL/FULL scratch setup measured 0.430–2.004 seconds; matching-row bootstrap 13.985 seconds and indexed shared-source bootstrap 31.857 seconds after both APIs bind. Runtime-observed bootstrap writer-loan p95/max were 50.032/497.658 ms; matching fixture max 319.893 ms. Large-batch runtime deletion repair added 5,006 VM steps/deleted row, 12,576 statements over 96 loans, max 224.209 ms. Single-row unrelated deletion median hold changed 17.0 to 29.4 ms on a noisy host; no timing improvement is claimed. Every page releases its background writer loan, prefers queued foreground work under the existing admission policy, and yields the Tokio task before another page. Earlier matching-fixture runs reached a 1.050-second loan. Whole open and deployed restart-to-health against the 30-second budget remain unmeasured; operations must measure at the first authorized deploy with a rollback plan. Native foreground contention over matching retained bodies in a complete native scratch Store measured 55.823/729.138 ms wait p95/max and 95.802/1033.528 ms total write p95/max across 874 writes and 568 bootstrap pages (34.563 seconds). Unused envelope/raw/predecessor and auxiliary time fields are synthetic; this is not full-source replay, admission or deployed startup.

manual.detail: No manual migration is required; the daemon advances bootstrap from its durable cursor. A corrupt historical source stops bootstrap with a doctor warning; repair the source and restart the daemon to resume.

recovery.detail: Earlier binaries ignore the additive local tables and retain their existing comparison. Persisted source triggers capture writes from earlier binaries; a later reopen drains exact pending deltas before evidence is treated as complete. Full replay rebuilds the local evidence asynchronously from retained claims; checkpoint-trimmed launch bodies remain Unknown.
